definitions: To draw or pull someone or something into a situation, activity, or place, often against their will or without them realizing it.
To involve someone deeply in a difficult or unpleasant situation.
To absorb or engulf something completely.
examples: The whirlpool began to suck the boat into its center.
He got sucked into a political argument at the party.
The company was sucked into a major scandal.
Don't let them suck you into their drama.
